subject: Draft MAP: Integration milestones & owners — WellPath x Redwood
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
To: Emily Nguyen <emily.nguyen@wellpath.io>, Mike Dillon <mike.dillon@wellpath.io>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-28 15:03 PST
Subject: Draft MAP: Integration milestones & owners — WellPath x Redwood

Hi Emily / Mike —

Thanks again for the demo today. Per our call, attaching a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and an integration requirements snapshot so we can align milestones, owners, and dependencies. Below is a concise recap and proposed owners/timelines for the integration milestone that matters most to your Q1 launch: the SDK + streaming/tool-calling integration for structured outputs.

Top-line ask: please confirm owners on your side and any hard constraints (e.g., freeze windows, procurement dates) so we can lock target close and resource allocations.

Proposed MAP milestones (draft):
1) Commercial & SOC2 procurement sign-off — Owner: Aisha (Sales) / Emily (WellPath) — Target: 2026-12-08
2) SDK integration POC (auth, basic generate/stream) — Owner: Laura Bennett (Redwood SE) / Mike Dillon (WellPath Eng Lead) — Target: 2026-12-22
3) Streaming + tool-calling enablement (LLM -> external tool calls + structured JSON outputs) — Owner: Jonas Weber (Redwood Infra) / Mike Dillon — Target: 2026-12-29
4) End-to-end test harness & QA (incl. rate/latency targets) — Owner: Marissa Cole (Customer Success) / WellPath QA — Target: 2027-01-05
5) Production cutover (dedicated environment) — Owner: Jonas / WellPath Ops — Target: 2027-01-19

Key dependencies / blockers:
- SOC2 evidence & security questionnaire responses (affects procurement sign-off)
- SSO/KMS details for token provisioning (security integration)
- Networking/VPC peering on WellPath side for dedicated environment
- Feature flags for structured output schema (schema v1 attached)

Attachments: MAP_v0.3.pdf (draft), integration requirements (summary).

Next steps (short):
- Emily: confirm owners and whether 12/22 POC date is feasible for Mike's team
- Mike: share any blackout windows or holiday coverage concerns
- Laura / Jonas / Marissa: review technical milestones and flag any infeasible items by EOD 11/30

I’ll update the MAP after we get your confirmations and share a calendar invite for a 30-min follow-up early next week.

Thanks —
Aisha
Aisha Rahman
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[aisha_rahman@redwood.com]
[Attachment: MAP_v0.3.pdf (PDF, 120KB)]

From: Emily Nguyen <emily.nguyen@wellpath.io>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Mike Dillon <mike.dillon@wellpath.io>
Date: 2026-11-30 09:12 EST
Subject: Re: Draft MAP: Integration milestones & owners — WellPath x Redwood

Thanks Aisha — good summary and helpful to see milestones laid out. A few notes from our side after internal sync: 

1) Timeline constraint: our product launch window is mid-Jan and we need the SDK POC completed by 2026-12-15 to give our QA team two weeks for validation. Can Redwood flex the POC owner/effort to hit 12/15?
2) Owners: Mike will own day-to-day integration on our side; please add him as primary technical contact for all dev tickets.
3) Security: we have an internal SOC2 review scheduled 12/06 — we need answers to the security questionnaire and sample audit logs by 12/04 to get through that cycle. Also need details on token rotation, KMS/HSM support, and data retention settings.
4) Networking: VPC peering for dedicated environment is possible but we have a 2-week change window starting 2026-12-20. If production cutover requires peering earlier, we'll need a formal change request.

Attached is our requirements spreadsheet (WellPath_requirements.xlsx) with columns for compliance items and dev constraints.

If Redwood can shift the SDK POC target to 12/15, we’ll confirm the QA window and lock the production cutover for the 01/19 date you proposed.

Best,
Emily
Emily Nguyen
Director, Product — WellPath Systems
[Attachment: WellPath_requirements.xlsx (XLSX, 62KB)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Nguyen <emily.nguyen@wellpath.io>, Mike Dillon <mike.dillon@wellpath.io>
Date: 2026-12-01 07:45 PST
Subject: Re: Draft MAP: Integration milestones & owners — WellPath x Redwood

Emily / Mike —

Appreciate the clarity on dates. We can compress the workstream to meet a 12/15 SDK POC target provided we prioritize the minimum viable integration surface: auth + generate stream + basic structured output schema v1. We should scope the POC to a small set of prompts and one tool-call path (calendar create) to validate streaming + tool calling end-to-end.

Updated technical milestones (internal):
- 12/02: API key & test tenant provisioning (Redwood infra) — Owner: Jonas
- 12/06: Baseline SDK auth + generate example (Redwood SE) — Owner: Laura
- 12/11: Streaming + tool-calling adapter (integrations module) — Owner: Laura / Mike
- 12/13: End-to-end dev QA in staging (both teams) — Owner: Mike / Marissa
- 12/15: Demo POC to WellPath stakeholders — Owner: Laura / Mike

Dependencies and asks from WellPath:
- Provide a test tenant and SSO/KMS contact (Mike) by 12/02
- Share example tool endpoints (calendar API sandbox) and expected JSON schema for structured outputs by 12/04

Notes on security: Jonas, we’ll need to produce sample audit logs and token rotation docs by 12/04 to help Emily’s SOC2 window. Can you pick this up?

I’ve attached a short tech note that outlines the POC scope and the SDK integration checklist. If everyone is aligned I’ll push a lightweight runbook into the shared Drive and update the MAP file.

Laura
Laura Bennett
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: integration-plan-technotes.md (TEXT, 8KB)]

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
To: Emily Nguyen <emily.nguyen@wellpath.io>, Mike Dillon <mike.dillon@wellpath.io>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-01 09:12 EST
Subject: Re: Draft MAP: Integration milestones & owners — WellPath x Redwood

Emily / Mike — thanks for the rapid turnaround and the requirements doc.

Summary / immediate actions:
- We’ll move the SDK POC target to 2026-12-15 (Laura + Mike).
- Jonas will produce sample audit logs & token rotation docs by 12/04 to support your SOC2 window.
- Mike: please share SSO/KMS contact and calendar sandbox endpoint by 12/02.

I’ve scheduled a 30-min follow-up for Tue 2026-12-07 10:00 AM ET — invite sent (please propose alternate times if needed). I also uploaded the revised MAP (v0.4) and the POC runbook to the shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cDEF-Redwood-WellPath-MAP

If there are no objections I’ll convert MAP_v0.3 to v0.4 after the call and attach an SOW draft for signature to move procurement.

Cheers —
Aisha
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Calendar invite: Redwood x WellPath MAP sync — 2026-12-07 10:00 AM ET]
